description:
Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

opencodex is a universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Grok Build: a local proxy that lets them run on many different LLM providers from a single port, translating between API wire formats.

Features:
- Works with Anthropic, Google, xAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Azure, DeepSeek, Ollama, and 40+ other built-in providers.
- Supports streaming, tool calls, reasoning, and images.
- Handles OAuth logins and a ChatGPT account pool.
- Native model picker in the Codex app, sub-agents, and search/vision sidecars.
Published to npm as @bitkyc08/opencodex@2.96.0 with dist-tag latest.
New Features
- Add opt-in MCP tools for stored Codex queues (#7999)
- Count fragmented NDJSON bytes incrementally (#8015)
Bug Fixes
- Exclude Meta for direct hosted tool choices (#8010)
- Honor disable and shutdown during startup sync (#8017)
- Bound CN PNG raster dimensions (#8021)
- Preserve server-issued batch for role suggestion --apply (#8022)
- Strip rejected reasoning toggle from native passthrough (#8025)
- Strip safety_identifier at the canonical ChatGPT forward destination (#8030)
- Support Ultra quota windows and show subscription names (#8055)
- Isolate Pool installation identity per account (#8065)
Chores
- Verify handle closure without racy fd probes (#8058)
- Await sibling startup completion instead of a polling deadline (#8062)
Other Changes
- Open dev at 2.96.0 before releasing 2.95.0 (#8033)
- Promote frozen tip 007dbfd895 to main as 2.96.0 (#8069)
